gui.wtem.select.title: WTEM source selection
gui.wtem.select.empty.description: No data-packs, SavedData files, or entity types were found.
gui.wtem.main.warn.text:
Extracting may damage the save and cause irreversible loss. Continuing will make a backup of the save and then start extraction.
Confirm again whether to continue. You can still cancel in the next step.
gui.wtem.main.title: World Translation Extractor
gui.wtem.main.info.summary: Extracted: Entries: %s | Chunks: %s | Resources: %s | Saved Data: %s
gui.wtem.config.title: WTEM Configuration
gui.wtem.config.nbt_max_depth.descriptio: Maximum nested NBT depth to visit (1-128).
gui.wtem.config.rebuild_nested_keys.desc: Start a fresh key for nested item data.
gui.wtem.config.stage.region.description: Extract block entities stored in world chunks.
gui.wtem.config.stage.entities.descripti: Extract entities stored in entity region files.
gui.wtem.config.stage.scoreboard.descrip: Extract scoreboard teams, objectives, and score display text.
gui.wtem.config.stage.datapacks.descript: Extract world data-packs into companion override packs.
gui.wtem.config.stage.generated_structur: Extract structure NBT below the generated directory.
gui.wtem.config.stage.storage.descriptio: Extract *.dat files below data/ except vanilla SavedData.
gui.wtem.config.resource.description: Controls whether this data-pack resource kind is extracted.
gui.wtem.config.filters.region.descripti: Comma-separated, a normal rule includes a location, `!` excludes it, and `*`/`?` are wildcards; exclusions always win. Location: dimension/chunk/x_z.
gui.wtem.config.filters.datapack.descrip: Comma-separated, a normal rule includes a location, `!` excludes it, and `*`/`?` are wildcards; exclusions always win. Location: pack/namespace:path.
gui.wtem.config.filters.storage.descript: Match `<path below data>.dat/<NBT path>`; supports `!` exclusions and `*`/`?` wildcards.
gui.wtem.config.filters.entity.descripti: Include or exclude namespaced entity type IDs such as minecraft:zombie.
gui.wtem.config.filters.block_entity.des: Include or exclude namespaced block-entity type IDs such as minecraft:lectern.
gui.wtem.config.key_reuse.default.descri: Reuse an existing key when the same text appears again.
gui.wtem.config.key_naming.scheme.descri: Choose structured, hashed, random, or ai.
gui.wtem.config.key_naming.random_length: Number of letters in random keys.
gui.wtem.config.outputs.region_snbt.desc: Write each selected region chunk as an SNBT file.
gui.wtem.config.outputs.schema.descripti: Write a machine-readable schema beside the language file.
gui.wtem.config.outputs.region_directory: Directory relative to the world root.
gui.wtem.config.outputs.schema_file.desc: Plain JSON file name relative to the world root.
gui.wtem.config.language_file.descriptio: Plain .json file name written to the world root.
gui.wtem.config.ai.enabled.description: Call the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint after a successful run.
gui.wtem.config.ai.protocol.description: Use Responses or Chat Completions; the provider must support the selected protocol.
gui.wtem.config.ai.endpoint.description: HTTP(S) API base URL or a complete /responses or /chat/completions URL.
gui.wtem.config.ai.api_key.description: Stored in wtem.json; please keep it safe.
gui.wtem.config.ai.model.description: Model name accepted by the endpoint.
gui.wtem.config.ai.target_language.descr: BCP-47 language name sent to the model.
gui.wtem.config.ai.output_file.descripti: Plain JSON file name in the world root.
gui.wtem.config.ai.translation_prompt.de: System prompt for the one-request catalog translation; {target_language} is replaced with the target language.
gui.wtem.config.ai.key_naming_prompt.des: System prompt for semantic keys; the original text and suggested path are sent separately.
gui.wtem.config.resource_pack.enabled.de: Build a client resource pack after a successful run.
gui.wtem.config.resource_pack.format.des: Choose folder, zip, or both; zip is the default.
gui.wtem.config.resource_pack.name: Resource-pack name
gui.wtem.config.resource_pack.name.descr: Resource-pack file name (.zip is optional); the directory is selected automatically for the Minecraft version.
gui.wtem.config.resource_pack.pack_forma: Use the current Minecraft format when set to zero.
gui.wtem.config.skipped.command_output.d: Do not translate cached command-block output.
gui.wtem.config.skipped.filtered_text.de: Do not translate chat-filtered sign/book duplicates.
gui.wtem.config.skipped_paths.descriptio: Directory exclusions evaluated with the data-pack globs; namespace:path and legacy path-only rules are accepted.
gui.wtem.config.saved_data_text_fields.d: One field name per line; matching is case-insensitive.
gui.wtem.select.datapacks.description: Extract only checked world data-packs; checking all leaves future packs unrestricted.
gui.wtem.select.entities.description: Extract only checked available entity types; values come from this version's registry.
gui.wtem.select.block_entities.descripti: Extract only checked available block-entity types; values come from this version's registry.
gui.wtem.select.storage_files.descriptio: Extract only checked SavedData files; vanilla SavedData is not listed.
